name: EPIC 212485053
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 11.4 solar radii and 1.28 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,915 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.28 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,265 K at its surface.
